panels.title: Idle Databases (no activity in 7 days)

targets.rawSql:
WITH i AS (SELECT * FROM (
WITH db_sizes AS (
    SELECT server_id, database_name,
           SUM(total_size_mb) AS total_size_mb,
           COUNT(*) AS file_count
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND (server_id, collection_time) IN (SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) FROM collect.v_database_size_stats WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) GROUP BY server_id)
    GROUP BY server_id, database_name
),
db_activity AS (
    SELECT server_id, database_name,
           SUM(execution_count_sum) AS total_executions,
           MAX(last_execution_time_max) AS last_execution
    FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND bucket >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND execution_count_sum IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY server_id, database_name
),
idle_dbs AS (
    SELECT ds.server_id, ds.database_name, ds.total_size_mb,
           ds.file_count,
           a.last_execution
    FROM db_sizes ds
    LEFT JOIN db_activity a
           ON a.server_id = ds.server_id AND a.database_name = ds.database_name
    WHERE COALESCE(a.total_executions, 0) = 0
      AND ds.database_name NOT IN ('master', 'model', 'msdb', 'tempdb', 'PerformanceMonitor')
)
SELECT server_id, database_name, total_size_mb, file_count, last_execution
FROM idle_dbs
) AS hourly_tier WHERE COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '7 days', false)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
WITH db_sizes AS (
    SELECT server_id, database_name,
           SUM(total_size_mb) AS total_size_mb,
           COUNT(*) AS file_count
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND (server_id, collection_time) IN (SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) FROM collect.v_database_size_stats WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) GROUP BY server_id)
    GROUP BY server_id, database_name
),
db_activity AS (
    SELECT server_id, database_name,
           SUM(delta_execution_count) AS total_executions,
           MAX(last_execution_time) AS last_execution
    FROM collect.v_query_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND delta_execution_count IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY server_id, database_name
),
idle_dbs AS (
    SELECT ds.server_id, ds.database_name, ds.total_size_mb,
           ds.file_count,
           a.last_execution
    FROM db_sizes ds
    LEFT JOIN db_activity a
           ON a.server_id = ds.server_id AND a.database_name = ds.database_name
    WHERE COALESCE(a.total_executions, 0) = 0
      AND ds.database_name NOT IN ('master', 'model', 'msdb', 'tempdb', 'PerformanceMonitor')
)
SELECT server_id, database_name, total_size_mb, file_count, last_execution
FROM idle_dbs
) AS raw_tier WHERE NOT COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '7 days', false))
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    i.database_name AS "Database",
    round(i.total_size_mb, 2) AS "Total Size MB",
    i.file_count AS "Files",
    i.last_execution AS "Last Execution"
FROM i
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = i.server_id
ORDER BY i.total_size_mb DESC

panels.description: Fixed 7-day window. System databases and PerformanceMonitor are never counted. Last Execution is the monitored server's local clock.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id, user_object_reserved_mb, internal_object_reserved_mb,
           version_store_reserved_mb, total_reserved_mb
    FROM collect.v_tempdb_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
peak AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           MAX(user_object_reserved_mb) AS max_user_mb,
           MAX(internal_object_reserved_mb) AS max_internal_mb,
           MAX(version_store_reserved_mb) AS max_version_store_mb,
           MAX(total_reserved_mb) AS max_total_mb
    FROM collect.v_tempdb_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY server_id
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    m.metric AS "Metric",
    round(m.current_mb, 2) AS "Current MB",
    round(m.peak_mb, 2) AS "Peak 24h MB",
    m.warning AS "Warning"
FROM latest l
JOIN peak p ON p.server_id = l.server_id
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = l.server_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('User Objects', l.user_object_reserved_mb, p.max_user_mb,
     CASE WHEN p.max_user_mb > 1024 THEN 'High user object usage' ELSE '' END),
    ('Internal Objects', l.internal_object_reserved_mb, p.max_internal_mb,
     CASE WHEN p.max_internal_mb > 1024
          THEN 'High internal object usage (sorts/hashes)' ELSE '' END),
    ('Version Store', l.version_store_reserved_mb, p.max_version_store_mb,
     CASE WHEN p.max_version_store_mb > 2048
          THEN 'Version store pressure - check long-running transactions' ELSE '' END),
    ('Total Reserved', l.total_reserved_mb, p.max_total_mb, '')
) AS m(metric, current_mb, peak_mb, warning)
ORDER BY srv.name, m.metric

panels.title: Wait Stats Summary

targets.rawSql:
WITH categorized AS (
    SELECT ws.server_id,
           CASE
        WHEN ws.wait_type IN ('SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD', 'CXPACKET', 'CXCONSUMER',
                             'CXSYNC_PORT', 'CXSYNC_CONSUMER') THEN 'CPU'
        WHEN ws.wait_type ILIKE 'PAGEIOLATCH%'
          OR ws.wait_type IN ('WRITELOG', 'IO_COMPLETION', 'ASYNC_IO_COMPLETION')
        THEN 'Storage'
        WHEN ws.wait_type IN ('RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE', 'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE_QUERY_COMPILE',
                             'CMEMTHREAD') THEN 'Memory'
        WHEN ws.wait_type = 'ASYNC_NETWORK_IO' THEN 'Network'
        WHEN ws.wait_type ILIKE 'LCK_M_%' THEN 'Locks'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS category,
           ws.wait_type,
           SUM(ws.delta_wait_time_ms) AS wait_time_ms,
           SUM(ws.delta_waiting_tasks) AS waiting_tasks
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats AS ws
    WHERE ws.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND $__timeFilter(ws.collection_time)
      AND ws.delta_wait_time_ms IS NOT NULL
      AND ws.delta_wait_time_ms > 0
    GROUP BY ws.server_id, CASE
        WHEN ws.wait_type IN ('SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD', 'CXPACKET', 'CXCONSUMER',
                             'CXSYNC_PORT', 'CXSYNC_CONSUMER') THEN 'CPU'
        WHEN ws.wait_type ILIKE 'PAGEIOLATCH%'
          OR ws.wait_type IN ('WRITELOG', 'IO_COMPLETION', 'ASYNC_IO_COMPLETION')
        THEN 'Storage'
        WHEN ws.wait_type IN ('RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE', 'RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE_QUERY_COMPILE',
                             'CMEMTHREAD') THEN 'Memory'
        WHEN ws.wait_type = 'ASYNC_NETWORK_IO' THEN 'Network'
        WHEN ws.wait_type ILIKE 'LCK_M_%' THEN 'Locks'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END, ws.wait_type
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT c.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.server_id, c.category ORDER BY c.wait_time_ms DESC) AS rn
    FROM categorized c
),
by_category AS (
    SELECT server_id, category,
           SUM(wait_time_ms) AS total_wait_time_ms,
           SUM(waiting_tasks) AS total_waiting_tasks,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN wait_type END) AS top_wait_type,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN wait_time_ms END) AS top_wait_time_ms
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY server_id, category
),
grand_total AS (
    SELECT server_id, NULLIF(SUM(total_wait_time_ms), 0) AS total
    FROM by_category
    GROUP BY server_id
),
budget AS (
    SELECT server_id, COALESCE(monthly_cost_usd, 0)::numeric AS monthly_cost
    FROM config.config_monitored_servers
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    bc.category AS "Category",
    bc.total_wait_time_ms AS "Total Wait ms",
    bc.total_waiting_tasks AS "Waiting Tasks",
    round(bc.total_wait_time_ms * 100.0 / gt.total, 1) AS "% of Total",
    bc.top_wait_type AS "Top Wait Type",
    bc.top_wait_time_ms AS "Top Wait ms",
    round(COALESCE(
        bc.total_wait_time_ms::numeric / gt.total * (b.monthly_cost * (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamp - $__timeFrom()::timestamp)) / 3600.0) / 730.0), 0), 2)
        AS "Est. Cost ($)"
FROM by_category bc
JOIN grand_total gt ON gt.server_id = bc.server_id
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.server_id = bc.server_id
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = bc.server_id
ORDER BY bc.total_wait_time_ms DESC

panels.description: Est. Cost is the category's share of the budget, prorated to the dashboard range.

panels.title: Expensive Queries (Top 20 by CPU)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_queries AS (
    SELECT qs.server_id,
           qs.database_name,
           SUM(qs.delta_worker_time) / 1000.0 AS total_cpu_ms,
           SUM(qs.delta_worker_time) / 1000.0
               / NULLIF(SUM(qs.delta_execution_count), 0) AS avg_cpu_ms,
           SUM(qs.delta_logical_reads) AS total_reads,
           SUM(qs.delta_logical_reads)::numeric
               / NULLIF(SUM(qs.delta_execution_count), 0) AS avg_reads,
           SUM(qs.delta_execution_count) AS executions,
           left(qs.query_text, 200) AS query_preview,
           qs.query_text AS full_query_text,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY qs.server_id
               ORDER BY SUM(qs.delta_worker_time) DESC) AS rn
    FROM collect.v_query_stats AS qs
    WHERE qs.server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND qs.collection_time >= GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamp, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days')
      AND qs.collection_time <= $__timeTo()::timestamp
      AND qs.delta_worker_time IS NOT NULL
      AND qs.delta_worker_time > 0
    GROUP BY qs.server_id, qs.database_name, qs.sql_handle, qs.query_text
),
kept AS (
    SELECT * FROM top_queries WHERE rn <= 20
),
totals AS (
    SELECT server_id, NULLIF(SUM(total_cpu_ms), 0) AS total_cpu
    FROM kept
    GROUP BY server_id
),
budget AS (
    SELECT server_id, COALESCE(monthly_cost_usd, 0)::numeric AS monthly_cost
    FROM config.config_monitored_servers
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    k.database_name AS "Database",
    round(k.total_cpu_ms, 0) AS "Total CPU ms",
    round(k.avg_cpu_ms, 2) AS "Avg CPU/Exec",
    k.total_reads AS "Total Reads",
    round(k.avg_reads, 0) AS "Avg Reads/Exec",
    k.executions AS "Executions",
    round(COALESCE(k.total_cpu_ms / t.total_cpu * (b.monthly_cost * (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamp - $__timeFrom()::timestamp)) / 3600.0) / 730.0), 0), 2)
        AS "Est. Cost ($)",
    k.query_preview AS "Query Preview",
    k.full_query_text AS "Query Text"
FROM kept k
JOIN totals t ON t.server_id = k.server_id
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.server_id = k.server_id
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = k.server_id
ORDER BY k.total_cpu_ms DESC

panels.description: Query text lives only in the raw tier, so this reaches back at most 3 days however wide the range. Upstream's stored-plan viewer has no Grafana equivalent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    mg.collection_time::date AS "Day",
    srv.name AS "Server",
    round(AVG(mg.granted_memory_mb), 1) AS "Avg Granted MB",
    round(AVG(mg.used_memory_mb), 1) AS "Avg Used MB",
    round(AVG(mg.used_memory_mb) * 100.0 / NULLIF(AVG(mg.granted_memory_mb), 0), 1)
        AS "Efficiency %",
    round(MAX(mg.granted_memory_mb), 1) AS "Peak Grant MB",
    round(AVG(mg.granted_memory_mb) - AVG(mg.used_memory_mb), 1) AS "Wasted MB",
    SUM(mg.grantee_count) AS "Grantees",
    SUM(mg.waiter_count) AS "Waiters",
    SUM(mg.timeout_error_count_delta) AS "Timeouts",
    SUM(mg.forced_grant_count_delta) AS "Forced"
FROM collect.v_memory_grant_stats AS mg
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = mg.server_id
WHERE mg.server_id IN (${server:csv})
  AND mg.collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY mg.collection_time::date, srv.name
ORDER BY mg.collection_time::date
